aiva_evidence.PS4: Not met: although observed in multiple unrelated probands with antithrombin deficiency (PMID:1469094, PMID:18480576, PMID:24814625, PMID:28229161, PMID:30799362, PMID:36214221), no formal matched case-control study demonstrating OR > 5 with 95% CI excluding 1 was reported (PMID:24814625 tested only 90 controls).

aiva_evidence.PM2: Not met: not absent from gnomAD for an autosomal dominant disorder; present in 2/1,614,008 alleles in gnomAD v4.1 (overall AF=1.24e-6; popmax AF=2.23e-5 in EAS, 0 homozygotes) per VEP.

aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable: missense substitution (p.Pro439Thr) with no change in protein length.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Met (Moderate): different missense substitutions at the same residue (p.Pro439) are established pathogenic variants for antithrombin deficiency, including p.Pro439Leu (AT Utah; PMID:3191114, PMID:7579451, UniProt:VAR_007084) with confirmed loss of thrombin inhibition and 10-fold reduced secretion, and p.Pro439Ala (Likely Pathogenic in ClinVar colocated alleles per VEP; PMID:16705712, PMID:23910795, PMID:36214221).
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met: no assumed de novo evidence reported.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Met (Supporting): co-segregates with antithrombin deficiency in 3 affected family members (proband, daughter, and son all carrying p.Pro439Thr with AT deficiency; PMID:18480576).
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not met: SERPINC1 is not missense-constrained per gnomad_constraint (mis_z=2.761 < 3.09; oe_mis_upper=0.792 >= 0.5).
aiva_evidence.PP3: Met (Moderate): REVEL=0.880 per VEP, exceeding the ClinGen SVI calibrated Moderate threshold (>=0.773 and <0.932; Pejaver 2022); PM1 (Moderate) + PP3 (Moderate) equals Strong, respecting the combined Strong cap.

aiva_evidence.BA1: Not met: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF is 2.23e-5 (overall AF=1.24e-6) per VEP, well below the >5% threshold.
aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF is 2.23e-5 per VEP, below the expected frequency threshold for autosomal dominant antithrombin deficiency.

aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met: no observation in trans or in cis with another pathogenic SERPINC1 variant reported.
aiva_evidence.BP3: Not applicable: missense variant, not an in-frame indel in a repetitive region.

aiva_rationale: No ClinGen VCEP covers SERPINC1, so generic ACMG/AMP 2015 rules apply. Met criteria counts by applied strength: 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PS3), 3 Moderate (PM1, PM5, PP3 at Moderate with PM1+PP3 capped at Strong), and 1 Supporting (PP1), with 0 benign criteria met (acmg_score=11). Under ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rule (c), 1 Strong + >=3 Moderate criteria establish a Pathogenic classification.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Lysosomal Diseases VCEP v1.2 specifications for IDUA (GN091). Note that the genomic coordinates on GRCh37 (4:997871 CGA>C) map via Ensembl VEP to ENST00000247933.4:c.1800_1801del (p.Thr601LeufsTer57) rather than the input HGVS string NM_000203.5:c.1799del (p.Ser600Ter); both lie downstream of c.1778 in the 3' region escaping NMD with <10% of the 653-aa protein altered/lost and therefore both receive PVS1_Moderate under GN091. Combined with PM2_Supporting (absent in gnomAD), the evidence totals 1 Pathogenic Moderate (PVS1_Moderate) and 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting), with 0 Benign criteria met (acmg_score = 3). Under GN091 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Very Strong + 1 Moderate, 1 Strong + 1 Moderate, 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting, >=3 Moderate, 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, or 1 Moderate + >=4 Supporting; thus, 1 Moderate + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic and classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

Pathogenic evidence comprises 1 Moderate (PP1_Moderate, weight 2) and 1 Supporting (PP3_Supporting, weight 1) criterion (total pathogenic weight 3), which does not reach Likely Pathogenic (requires >=3 Moderate, 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting, or 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate). Benign evidence comprises 1 Supporting criterion (BS1_Supporting, weight -1), which does not reach Likely Benign (requires >=2 Benign Supporting or 1 Benign Strong + 1 Benign Supporting). Because neither side reaches Likely Pathogenic or Likely Benign and pathogenic evidence outweighs benign evidence (acmg_score = 2), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

Pathogenic criteria met: 3 Strong (PS4_Strong, PM3_Strong, PP1_Strong), yielding a tally of 12 pathogenic points. Met criteria total 1 Pathogenic Moderate (PM1_Moderate: PHD domain aa 414-487) + 2 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting: gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF=3.39e-06 <0.0000588 and 0 homozygotes; PS3_Supporting: reduced V(D)J recombination activity per Couedel et al. 2010 PMID:20234091 and PMID:20190764), with 0 Benign criteria met (acmg_score=4). aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Limb Girdle Muscular Dystrophy VCEP ANO5 specifications v2.0 (GN188), which use Tavtigian 2020 Bayesian point rules (Pathogenic >=10 pts; Likely Pathogenic 6-9 pts; VUS 0-5 pts; Likely Benign -6 to -1 pts; Benign <=-7 pts or BA1). Met criteria: PM3 at Very Strong (+8 pts; confirmed in trans and homozygous LGMD/ANO5-myopathy cases), PP1 at Supporting (+1 pt; 1 affected segregation), and PP4 at Supporting (+1 pt; specific LGMD phenotype with biallelic ANO5 variants; PP1+PP4=2 pts, within the 5-pt cap). BS1 is not met as c.172C>T is an approved LGMD VCEP BS1 exception, and BA1 is not met (Grpmax FAF ~0.0026 <=0.003). Total score = 10 points, meeting Pathogenic (>=10 pts).

VEP on GRCh37 verified the genomic deletion allele (chr12:103260375_103260442del) and annotated it as ENST00000553106.1:c.442-1_508del (input label NM_000277.3:c.443_509+1del), which removes 67 coding nucleotides of exon 5 plus a canonical splice site upstream of c.1285, disrupting reading frame and predicted to undergo NMD. Although generic ClinGen SVI 2020 rules classify 1 VS + 1 P as Likely Pathogenic, VCEP spec GN006 explicitly supersedes the generic combining table and lacks a '1 Pathogenic Very Strong + 1 Pathogenic Supporting' rule (requiring >=1 Moderate or >=2 Supporting alongside PVS1 to reach Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic). Therefore, this variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under Variant-Class Precedence, NM_001354304.2:c.442-4403_509+883del (GRCh37 chr12:103259492-103264845del) is a 5,354 bp (>1 kb) single-gene intragenic deletion encompassing 1 protein-coding gene (PAH, HGNC:8582) and is governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al., Genet Med 2020;22:245-257, PMID: 31690835; correction Genet Med 2021;23:2230, PMID: 33731880) Copy Number Loss Scoring Metric rather than the ACMG/AMP 2015 sequence-variant framework. ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map ratings for PAH (HGNC:8582, Gene ID 5053, evaluated 2014-08-28) are Haploinsufficiency Score = 30 (Gene associated with autosomal recessive phenotype, MONDO:0009861) and Triplosensitivity Score = 0 (No evidence available). Scoring under Riggs et al. 2020 Table 1: Section 1A = 0.00 (contains protein-coding exon 5 of PAH, c.442_509); Section 2E = +0.90 (both breakpoints lie within PAH; deletion of the 68 nt out-of-frame coding exon 5 upstream of c.1285 is predicted to cause frameshift and NMD, meeting PVS1 at Very Strong per ClinGen SVI PVS1 guidelines and ClinGen PAH VCEP v2.1 doc_id GN006); Section 3A = 0.00 (1 protein-coding gene, 0-24 tier); Section 4E = +0.30 (0.10 points per proband, capped at 0.30, for >=3 unrelated PKU probands in the literature with overlapping single-exon 5 PAH deletions and a highly specific PKU phenotype, e.g. 19 Czech cases in PMID: 16931086, 2 Danish/German cases in PMID: 17221866, 3 Slovene cases in PMID: 22513348, Ukrainian cases in PMID: 30258912, and 1 Serbian case in PMID: 40473815); Section 5F = 0.00 (proband inheritance unavailable). Total Riggs et al. 2020 score = 1.20 points, exceeding the >=0.99 threshold for Pathogenic (summary ACMG tally for the invoked PVS1 code = 8).

aiva_rationale: Applied ClinGen RASopathy Expert Panel specifications for PTPN11 (GN043 v2.3). aiva_rationale: Under Variant-Class Precedence, NM_000277.1:c.-4165_-407del3759 (GRCh37 chr12:103,311,317-103,315,075; NC_000012.11:g.103311316_103315074del) is a 3,759 bp (>1 kb) copy-number loss and is therefore governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al. 2020, Genet Med 22:245-257, v1.0; PMID:31690835) rather than the ACMG/AMP 2015 sequence-variant criteria or PAH VCEP GN006 v2.1 sequence-variant rules. Interval size: 3,759 bp. Protein-coding gene count: 1 (PAH, HGNC:8582, 5' UTR ENST00000553106.1:c.-473_-409del plus promoter ENSR12_93HSXC and CTCF binding site ENSR12_5W7L3T per VEP). ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map ratings for PAH (CCID:007610, ISCA-9235): Haploinsufficiency Score = 30 (Gene Associated with Autosomal Recessive Phenotype) and Triplosensitivity Score = 0 (No Evidence for Triplosensitivity). Copy-Number Loss scoring per Riggs et al. 2020: Section 1A = 0 pts (contains 5' UTR and functional promoter/liver-specific enhancer elements per VEP and PMID:11935335; continue evaluation); Section 2A-2D = 0 pts (PAH has HI score 30 for AR disease rather than HI score 3, and only the 5' UTR/upstream region is involved where 2C-2 default = 0 pts); Section 2E = 0 pts (PVS1/PM4 N/A as no coding exons are deleted); Section 2F-2G = 0 pts (no overlap with established benign CNV); Section 2H = 0 pts (gnomAD pLI=7.06e-23, LOEUF=1.27, DECIPHER %HI=20.97); Section 3A = 0 pts (1 protein-coding gene, 0-24 range); Section 4E = +0.30 pts (reported in >=3 unrelated PAH-deficiency patients/families in PMID:11935335 and PMID:24401910 in compound heterozygosity with p.E76G confirmed in trans, p.R408Q, and p.E286K, supported by 1% wild-type CAT transcriptional activity in PMID:11935335); Section 4O = 0 pts (absent from gnomAD >31,000 alleles, VEP, and MyVariant); Section 5H = +0.30 pts (inheritance unavailable for this proband, stated phenotype phenylketonuria is specific and consistent with PAH deficiency). Total Riggs et al. 2020 score = +0.60 points, which falls within the Uncertain Significance range (-0.89 to +0.89; Pathogenic >=0.99, Likely Pathogenic 0.90-0.98) and leans pathogenic -> VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note: ClinGen EvRepo (CA281520) previously curated this deletion under PAH VCEP sequence-variant rules as Likely Pathogenic (PM2, PM3_Strong, PS3_Supporting, PP4), whereas the dominant-HI-calibrated CNV technical standard does not award recessive in-trans or standalone reporter-assay points; acmg_score = 0 reflects that 0 ACMG/AMP 2015 sequence-variant criteria apply under Variant-Class Precedence.

aiva_rationale: Although the submitted annotation referenced the overlapping antisense gene C12orf43 (NM_022895.3:c.*3036_*3037del, downstream/3'UTR on the reverse strand with no monogenic diabetes link), VEP annotation of genomic variant 12:121438921:AGC:A (GRCh37) reveals a HIGH-impact frameshift variant in HNF1A (ENST00000257555.6 / NM_000545.8:c.1823_1824del, p.Ser608ThrfsTer40), the established causal gene for autosomal dominant monogenic diabetes (MODY3). Applying ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes Expert Panel Specifications for HNF1A (GN017 v3.1), the variant meets PVS1 at Strong (frameshift in exon 10, 3' of c.1768 and 5' of c.1854/p.618) and PM2 at Supporting (absent in gnomAD per VEP and MyVariant), yielding 1 Strong + 1 Supporting pathogenic criterion (acmg_score = 5). Under GN017 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting or 1 Strong + 1 Moderate; therefore, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: VEP annotation of chr12:121438952 TCG>T (GRCh37) shows that while the input notation NM_022895.3:c.*3003_*3004del maps to the 3' UTR/downstream region of C12orf43 on the minus strand, the same variant overlaps exon 10 of HNF1A on the plus strand as ENST00000257555.6 (NM_000545.8):c.1854_1855del (p.Glu619AspfsTer29), directly relevant to the stated autosomal dominant monogenic diabetes phenotype. Applying the ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes VCEP HNF1A v3.1 specification (GN017), two Pathogenic Supporting criteria are met (PVS1 at Supporting for a frameshift altering amino acids 3' of p.Ile618, and PM2 at Supporting for absence from gnomAD) and zero benign criteria are met (total counts: 0 VS, 0 S, 0 M, 2 P; acmg_score=2). Under GN017 combining rules, 2 Pathogenic Supporting criteria do not reach Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic (and even if PVS1 were applied at Strong based on nucleotide start c.1854, 1 S + 1 P still does not reach Likely Pathogenic under GN017), yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Applying ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP specifications (GN005) for autosomal recessive nonsyndromic genetic deafness, the pathogenic criteria met are PM3 (Very Strong), PVS1 (Strong), PS4 (Strong), and PP1 (Strong), yielding 1 Very Strong + 3 Strong pathogenic criteria, which satisfies Pathogenic rules (a) >=1 VS + >=1 S and (b) >=2 S. On the benign side, only BS1 (Strong) is met (gnomAD v4.1 South Asian AF 0.415% >= 0.3% AR cutoff), which does not reach Benign (>=2 BS) or Likely Benign (1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP; and GN005 limits BS1 alone to Likely Benign only when no conflicting pathogenic evidence exists, plus c.71G>A is on the HL-EP exclusion list). With Pathogenic criteria met and no conflicting benign class reached (ACMG score=16), the variant is classified as Pathogenic.

With a net ACMG score of -3 (-4 from BS1, +1 from PP3), the benign population frequency evidence outweighs the computational prediction, yielding VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP specifications (GN005 v2.0) and the ClinGen SVI PVS1 flowchart (PMID:30192042), NM_004004.6:c.2T>G meets 1 Moderate pathogenic criterion (PVS1_Moderate for an initiation codon variant with no alternative GJB2 start codons and pathogenic variant c.35delG 5' of downstream Met34) and 1 Supporting pathogenic criterion (PM2_Supporting for absence in gnomAD). No benign criteria are met. Under Richards et al. 2015 and GN005/Oza et al. 2018 combining rules (where GN005's recessive Likely Pathogenic shortcut requires full-strength PVS1 + PM2_Supporting), 1 Moderate + 1 Supporting (acmg_score=3) does not reach Pathogenic or Likely Pathogenic and therefore classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP specifications (GN005 v2.0) and ACMG/AMP combining rules (GN005 defines no separate combining or points rules), the met criteria total 1 Moderate (PVS1_Moderate) and 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting), yielding acmg_score=3. Neither Pathogenic nor Likely Pathogenic thresholds (minimum 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting, or 1 Strong + 1 Moderate, or 3 Moderate, or 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting) nor Benign/Likely Benign thresholds are met, so the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PS1: Not met (GN005): Non-coding 5' UTR variant; the colocated variant at this nucleotide (c.-22-2A>G, rs201895089) is listed as uncertain_significance in ClinVar per VEP, not an established pathogenic variant.

aiva_evidence.PS4: Not met (GN005): Autosomal recessive GJB2 deafness without statistically significant case-control enrichment (0/1,500 Spanish HI patients in PMID:24039984; 1/1,200 alleles in PMID:33096615 vs gnomAD AF up to 0.004896 in ASJ).
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not met (GN005): GN005 restricts PM1 to the KCNQ4 pore-forming region, and this variant is in non-coding 5' UTR intron 1 of GJB2.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP specifications (GN005 v2.0) and ACMG/AMP combining rules: on the pathogenic side, 2 Moderate (PM3, PP1) and 2 Supporting (PS3, PP3) criteria are met (+6 points), which would reach Likely Pathogenic (2 M + >=2 P). On the benign side, 1 Strong criterion (BS1; gnomadg_asj=0.004896 >= 0.003) is met (-4 points), which under GN005 supports Likely Benign only in the absence of conflicting evidence. Because strong population frequency evidence (BS1) directly conflicts with cosegregation, in-trans, functional RNA, and SpliceAI evidence (net acmg_score = +2), the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP GN005 v2.0 (which specifies no custom combining_rules or points_rules, defaulting to ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules), the variant meets 2 Moderate pathogenic criteria (PVS1_Moderate + PS3_Moderate; score=4; 0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 2 Moderate, 0 Supporting; 0 Benign). Likely Pathogenic requires at least 3 Moderate criteria (or 2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting), so 2 Moderate criteria classify the variant as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen LGMD VCEP Specifications for SGCG v2.0 (GN185) Bayesian point rules (Pathogenic >=10, Likely Pathogenic 6 to 9, Uncertain Significance 0 to 5, Likely Benign -6 to -1, Benign <=-7), met criteria are PVS1 at Moderate (+2 pts) and PM2 at Supporting (+1 pt), yielding 3 points total, which classifies as Uncertain Significance (VUS, leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Hearing Loss VCEP v2.0 specifications (GN005; PMID:30311386) and ClinGen SVI PVS1 guidance (PMID:30192042) for autosomal recessive nonsyndromic genetic deafness, the variant meets 2 Moderate criteria (PVS1_Moderate for start-loss with pathogenic variants 5' of Met34; PM5 for pathogenic c.1A>G p.Met1Val at the same codon) and 2 Supporting criteria (PM2_Supporting for gnomAD v4.1 popmax AF <=0.007%; PM3_Supporting for 1 phase-unknown observation with a pathogenic variant in bilateral SNHL). aiva_rationale: Applied strength counts under ClinGen SCID VCEP FOXN1 v2.3 (GN113): 1 Pathogenic Strong (PVS1_Strong) + 1 Pathogenic Supporting (PM2_Supporting), ACMG score = 5. Note that VEP maps the GRCh37 allele 17:26862054 CAG>C to ENST00000226247.2:c.1466_1467del (p.Gln489ArgfsTer39), which is a 2-bp deletion rather than the 1-bp c.1465del (p.Q489Rfs*61) string in the input metadata. Because the premature termination codon at residue 527 lies downstream of c.1577 (codon 526) in exon 8, NMD is not predicted, and disruption/loss of the FOXN1 transactivation domain (aa 511-563) qualifies for PVS1_Strong rather than PVS1_VeryStrong per GN113. Under GN113 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Pathogenic Strong + 1 Pathogenic Moderate or 1 Pathogenic Strong + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting (or 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting); therefore, 1 Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic and classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PS2: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: BRCA1/2-related cancers occur relatively commonly and de novo predictive capacity is uncalibrated.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met (Strong) per GN092 v1.2: well-established saturation genome editing (SGE) functional assay measuring endogenous mRNA and protein effect in HAP1 cells demonstrated loss-of-function comparable to pathogenic control variants per PMID:30209399 and ClinGen Evidence Repository curation (CA001412).
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not met per GN092 v1.2: although reported as a Belgian founder variant in HBOC families (PMID:10595255), no case-control analysis meeting OR >= 4 (lower CI > 2.0) and p <= 0.05 was identified.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: functional domain consideration is incorporated into bioinformatic analysis (PP3/BP4).
aiva_evidence.PM2: Not met per GN092 v1.2: variant is present in gnomAD (gnomAD exomes AF=7.032e-07, NFE=9.273e-07; gnomAD genomes AF=6.569e-06, NFE=1.47e-05 per annotate_variant VEP; MyVariant gnomAD genome AC=1, AF=3.185e-05; present in gnomAD non-cancer subsets per ClinGen evrepo) and therefore not absent from controls.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not met per GN092 v1.2: no evidence of biallelic co-occurrence with a pathogenic BRCA1 variant in a Fanconi Anemia phenotype.
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: considered as a component of bioinformatic analysis (PP3/BP4).
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met per GN092 v1.2: applies only to protein termination codon (PTC) variants in exons with other proven pathogenic PTC variants; c.212+3A>G is an intronic splice-region variant.
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: de novo evidence is not applicable for BRCA1.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met per GN092 v1.2: while observed in multiple Belgian HBOC families (PMID:10595255), no standalone quantitative co-segregation Bayes score LR >= 2.08:1 independent of multifactorial clinical data (PP4) was reported.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: high frequency of benign missense variants in BRCA1 (gnomAD constraint mis_z=1.73, oe_mis_upper=0.947 per annotate_variant); also not a missense variant.

aiva_evidence.PP4: Met (Very Strong) per GN092 v1.2: multifactorial likelihood ratio analysis produced a combined clinical LR of 1615.48 (Co-occurrence LR=1.298; Family History LR=1245.06), exceeding the PP4_Very Strong threshold of LR >= 350:1 per PMID:17924331, PMID:31853058, and ClinGen Evidence Repository curation (CA001412).

aiva_evidence.BS1: Not met per GN092 v1.2: gnomAD AF (7.032e-07 exomes, 6.569e-06 genomes per annotate_variant VEP) is below the VCEP BS1_Supporting threshold of FAF > 0.00002 (and BS1 Strong > 0.0001).
aiva_evidence.BS2: Not met per GN092 v1.2: no biallelic observations without Fanconi Anemia features documented.
aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met per GN092 v1.2: SGE functional study (PMID:30209399) showed damaging loss of function rather than normal function.

aiva_evidence.BP1: Not met per GN092 v1.2: applies to silent, missense, or in-frame variants outside critical domains with SpliceAI <= 0.1; this is an intronic variant with SpliceAI DS_DL=0.635.
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not applicable per GN092 v1.2: applied only in the context of BS2.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen ENIGMA BRCA1 VCEP Specification v1.2 (GN092). Met criteria comprise 2 Very Strong codes (PVS1 [RNA] from consistent patient RT-PCR/ddPCR and minigene splicing assays showing exon 5 22-nt deletion/skipping; PP4_Very Strong from multifactorial clinical LR=1615.48 >= 350:1) and 1 Strong code (PS3 from calibrated SGE functional assay), yielding an ACMG score of 20. Standard ACMG/AMP combining rules retained by GN092 apply: >=1 Very Strong + >=1 Strong (and >=2 Very Strong) definitively meets the threshold for Pathogenic.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (GN011 v2.1) for ITGA2B and Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Two pathogenic Supporting criteria are met: PM2 (Supporting, absent in gnomAD, <0.0001) and PP3 (Supporting, REVEL=0.843 >= 0.7). No Very Strong, Strong, Moderate, or Benign criteria are met (counts: 0 VS, 0 S, 0 M, 2 P, 0 BA1, 0 BS, 0 BM, 0 BP; acmg_score=2). Because GN011 specifies no custom combining rules, generic ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply; 2 Supporting criteria do not reach Likely Pathogenic or Pathogenic thresholds, yielding VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B/ITGB3 (GN011 v2.1; PMID:33496739), only PM2 is met at Supporting strength (0 Very Strong, 0 Strong, 0 Moderate, 1 Supporting; 0 Benign Stand-alone/Strong/Moderate/Supporting; acmg_score=1). Note that VCF coordinates 17:42449764:GTG:G (GRCh37) annotate via VEP as ENST00000262407.5:c.3087_3088del (p.Leu1031GlyfsTer4), whereas the provided HGVS NM_000419.5:c.3091del is a 1-bp deletion at the same codon; under GN011 both affect the last exon (exon 30) and ITGA2B cytoplasmic tail downstream of the transmembrane domain, so NMD is not predicted, no VCEP-specified critical LOF region is disrupted, and PVS1 is not met. With only PM2_Supporting met, neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic nor Benign/Likely Benign thresholds are reached, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Applied at Strong (PVS1_Strong) per ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP (GN011) and SVI PVS1 decision tree: VEP annotates 17:42451807:TCC:T as frameshift ENST00000262407.5:c.2973_2974del (p.Arg993GlyfsTer42) in ITGA2B (LOF is an established mechanism of autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia per GN011); stop codon occurs at codon 1034 in the final exon 30 (NM_000419.4 CDS 3061-3120), so NMD is not predicted, but the frameshift disrupts the ITGA2B transmembrane domain (aa 994-1019 per UniProt:P08514), explicitly defined in GN011 as a region critical to protein function.

aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per GN011: VCEP specifies PS4 does not apply to Glanzmann thrombasthenia due to rarity of the disorder and lack of appropriate case-control studies.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Not applicable per GN011: VCEP specifies PM1 does not apply because ITGA2B and ITGB3 are highly polymorphic with no known mutational hot spots (PMID:25827233).

aiva_evidence.PM4: Not met per GN011: frameshift deletion, not an in-frame indel or stop-loss variant.

aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met per GN011: no assumed de novo evidence and no second known P/LP variant in the proband reported.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met per GN011: no family co-segregation data provided.

aiva_evidence.PP3: Not met per GN011: frameshift variant with no missense REVEL score (threshold >=0.7 applies to missense variants), and SpliceAI max_delta=0.112 per VEP does not meet splicing prediction criteria.
aiva_evidence.PP4: Not met per GN011: clinical context states Glanzmann thrombasthenia, but lacks documented mucocutaneous bleeding symptoms, platelet aggregometry (minimal/no aggregation with >=2 agonists with normal ristocetin), and full ITGA2B/ITGB3 sequencing or surface expression data required by GN011.

aiva_evidence.BS3: Not met per GN011: no functional studies demonstrating normal expression and protein function or normal transgenic mouse aggregometry.
aiva_evidence.BS4: Not met per GN011: no non-segregation in affected family members reported.
aiva_evidence.BP1: Not applicable per GN011: VCEP specifies BP1 does not apply as truncating variants do not predominate and missense variants are a known cause of disease (variant is also frameshift).
aiva_evidence.BP2: Not met per GN011: no observation in cis with a pathogenic ITGA2B variant reported.

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (GN011 v2.1), the genomic variant 17:42451807:TCC:T (annotated by VEP as ENST00000262407.5:c.2973_2974del, p.Arg993GlyfsTer42; note the input HGVS label NM_000419.4:c.2975del refers to a different 1-bp deletion) meets PVS1 at Strong strength (NMD is not predicted because the PTC at codon 1034 lies in the final exon 30, but the frameshift disrupts the ITGA2B transmembrane domain aa 994-1019 specified as critical to protein function in GN011) and PM2 at Supporting strength (absent from gnomAD per VEP and MyVariant). With 1 Strong and 1 Supporting pathogenic criterion (acmg_score=5) and no benign criteria met, GN011 combining rules (which require at least 1 Strong plus 1-2 Moderate or >=2 Supporting for Likely Pathogenic) classify this variant as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Strong (PVS1_Strong) per ClinGen PD-EP VCEP (GN011, PMC7839359) and SVI PVS1 tree (PMID:30192042): LOF is an established mechanism of autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia (PMID:34149292, PMID:36672149); genomic variant 17:42452087GAA>G maps to ENST00000262407.5:c.2881_2882del (p.Phe961GlnfsTer74) in exon 28/30 of NM_000419.5 with PTC at codon 1034 in last exon 30 (downstream of penultimate exon NMD boundary c.3010), escaping NMD (likewise input HGVS c.2883del escapes NMD), and alters the entire transmembrane domain (aa 994-1019 per UniProt:P08514), a VCEP-specified critical region.

aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met per GN011: no assumed de novo data or second P/LP variant reported.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (GN011, v2.1; PMC7839359). Note that GRCh37 genomic coordinates 17:42452087 GAA>G correspond in Ensembl VEP to ENST00000262407.5:c.2881_2882del (p.Phe961GlnfsTer74) rather than the provided HGVS label NM_000419.5:c.2883del, though both affect codon 961 in exon 28, escape NMD, and disrupt the downstream transmembrane domain (aa 994-1019). Combining counts by applied strength: 0 Very Strong, 1 Strong (PVS1_Strong), 0 Moderate, 1 Supporting (PM2_Supporting), and 0 benign criteria (acmg_score = 5). Under GN011 and ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Strong + >=2 Supporting (or 1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate, or 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting), so 1 Strong + 1 Supporting does not reach Likely Pathogenic and classifies as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Met at Strong (PVS1_Strong) per ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP GN011 (PMID:33496739): LOF is an established mechanism of autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia in ITGA2B (PMID:25728920); exon 28 frameshift (17:42452068:AGG:A -> ENST00000262407.5:c.2900_2901del p.Pro967LeufsTer68 per Ensembl VEP; or NM_000419.5:c.2902del p.Tyr968MetfsTer163) escapes NMD (PTC at codon 1034 in last exon 30, or nonstop extension) but disrupts the GN011-specified critical transmembrane domain (aa 994-1019 per UniProt P08514).

aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met per GN011: no confirmed de novo or parental genotype data provided, and no second confirmed P/LP variant in proband.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Not met per GN011: no heterologous cell line or transgenic animal model functional studies identified for 17:42452068:AGG:A (c.2900_2901del) or c.2902del.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Not applicable per ClinGen VCEP GN011: rule does not apply due to rarity of Glanzmann thrombasthenia and lack of appropriate case-control studies.

aiva_rationale: Under ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP v2.1 specifications (GN011), met criteria are PVS1 at Strong strength (PVS1_Strong: exon 28 frameshift escaping NMD but disrupting the VCEP-specified critical transmembrane domain aa 994-1019) and PM2 at Supporting strength (PM2_Supporting: absent in gnomAD, <0.0001), yielding 1 Strong + 1 Supporting (acmg_score=5). Under GN011 combining rules, Likely Pathogenic requires at least 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting, 1 Strong + 1 Moderate, or 1 Strong + 2 Supporting; because 1 Strong + 1 Supporting falls short of Likely Pathogenic and no benign criteria are met, the variant is classified as VUS (leaning pathogenic). Note that the provided genomic coordinates (GRCh37 chr17:42452068 AGG>A) map to ENST00000262407.5:c.2900_2901del (p.Pro967LeufsTer68) in Ensembl VEP, whereas the provided HGVS string NM_000419.5:c.2902del (p.Tyr968MetfsTer163) is an adjacent 1-bp deletion; both are exon 28 frameshift deletions that escape NMD and disrupt aa 994-1019, resulting in the same met criteria and classification.

aiva_rationale: Applying ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications for ITGA2B (GN011 v2.1) and ClinGen SVI splicing guidelines (PMID:36865205), two Supporting criteria are met: PM2 at Supporting strength (gnomAD AF <0.0001 per GN011) and BP4 at Supporting strength (SpliceAI max_delta=0.064 <=0.1 indicating no predicted splicing impact). This yields 1 Pathogenic Supporting (+1) and 1 Benign Supporting (-1) criterion, for an acmg_score of 0. Because GN011 provides no custom combining rules, generic ACMG/AMP combining rules apply: neither Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic nor Benign/Likely Benign thresholds are met, resulting in VUS. Given the intronic -19 location with no predicted splicing impact (BP4) and presence in gnomAD (2 alleles in exomes, 1.315e-05 in genomes) without any case or functional evidence in literature, the overall evidence leans benign: VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under the ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specification for ITGA2B/ITGB3 (GN011 v2.1; PMID:33496739) for autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia. Note that the GRCh37 genomic change 17:42452040 CGG>C annotates via VEP as the 2-bp deletion ENST00000262407.5:c.2928_2929del (p.Glu979SerfsTer56) in exon 28 of 30, whereas the provided HGVS string NM_000419.5:c.2930del refers to an adjacent 1-bp deletion (reported in PMID:42576994). For 17:42452040 CGG>C, the premature stop codon falls at codon 1034 in the final exon 30 (downstream of the NMD boundary at WT CDS nt 3011), so NMD is not predicted; however, the frameshift begins upstream of and replaces the entire critical ITGA2B transmembrane domain (residues 994-1019), meeting PVS1 at Strong strength (1 Strong = 4 points) per GN011 and the SVI PVS1 decision tree (analogous to ITGA2B c.2852_2853delinsC in PMID:33496739 Table 2). The variant is absent from gnomAD per VEP and MyVariant, meeting PM2 at Supporting strength (1 Supporting = 1 point) per GN011 (<0.0001). Combining 1 Strong + 1 Supporting (acmg_score = 5) does not reach the Likely Pathogenic threshold (which requires 1 Very Strong + 1 Supporting under GN011, or >=1 Strong + 1-2 Moderate / >=2 Supporting under ACMG/AMP 2015), resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Applying ClinGen Platelet Disorders VCEP specifications (GN011, v2.1) with standard ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules, the variant meets PVS1 (Very Strong: frameshift deletion in exon 13 of 15 in ITGB3 predicting NMD and eliminating the critical transmembrane/cytoplasmic domains required for GPIIb/IIIa complex formation and surface expression, in a gene where LOF causes autosomal recessive Glanzmann thrombasthenia), PS3 (Strong: heterologous CHO/BHK cell assays of this exact 11-bp deletion demonstrate absent surface expression and loss of fibrinogen binding), and PM2 (Supporting: absent from gnomAD per VEP and MyVariant, <0.0001 threshold). aiva_rationale: Applying ClinGen Lysosomal Storage Disorders VCEP specifications for GAA (doc_id: GN010) with ACMG/AMP combining rules, the variant meets 1 Very Strong criterion (PVS1: frameshift p.Ala14GlyfsTer18 introducing a premature stop codon at codon 31, before codon 916) and 1 Moderate criterion (PM2: absent from gnomAD, below the GN010 0.001 MAF threshold), yielding an ACMG score of 10. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Lysosomal Storage Disorders VCEP specifications for GAA (GN010 v2.0). Five pathogenic criteria are met: PM3 at Strong (1 S; >=2.0 points from >=4 compound heterozygous Pompe patients with pathogenic second alleles), PM2 at Moderate (1 M; gnomAD AF <0.001 in all continental populations per GN010 v2.0), PP4 at Moderate (1 M; >=4 patients with Pompe phenotype and documented GAA deficiency), PS3 at Supporting (1 P; <5% WT GAA activity in COS cells), and PP3 at Supporting (1 P; REVEL=0.757 >0.7). aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Rett and Angelman-like Disorders VCEP specifications for TCF4 v6.0 (doc_id: GN032), met criteria are PVS1 (Very Strong) and PM2 (Supporting, PM2_Supporting), giving 1 Pathogenic Very Strong + 1 Pathogenic Supporting (acmg_score = 9). GN032 combining_rules require at least 1 VS + 1 M (or 1 S + 1 M / >=2 P, >=3 M, etc.) for Likely Pathogenic and do not include a 1 VS + 1 P rule; because VCEP combining_rules supersede generic rules without adding unstated rules, neither Pathogenic nor Likely Pathogenic thresholds are reached, resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Applying ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 (doc_id: GN012, PMID:33767344) with standard ACMG/AMP combining rules, pathogenic criteria total 2 Strong (PS4, PP1) and 3 Moderate (PS2, PM1, PP3), which meets Pathogenic (>=2 Pathogenic Strong; also 1 Strong + >=3 Moderate). On the benign side, only 1 Moderate criterion (BS2) is met, which does not reach Likely Benign or Benign, so there is no class-level conflict and the final classification is Pathogenic (acmg_score=12).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility Expert Panel specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012). Met criteria by applied strength: 1 Strong (PP1), 2 Moderate (PM1, PP3), and 1 Supporting (PS4), yielding acmg_score=9 and no met benign criteria. Combining 1 Strong + 2 Moderate (+ 1 Supporting) satisfies the 1 S + 1-2 M rule for Likely Pathogenic (one Supporting criterion short of Pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), which specify no custom combining rules and therefore use standard ACMG/AMP combining rules. Two Moderate criteria (PM1 in N-terminal domain residues 1-552; PP3 with REVEL=0.940 >0.85) and two Supporting criteria (PS3_Supporting from two independent ex vivo muscle/myotube studies; PS4_Supporting from unrelated gnomAD-absent Japanese MH probands) are met, yielding 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting (acmg_score=6), which meets the Likely Pathogenic rule (2 Moderate + >=2 Supporting) with no benign criteria met.

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Congenital Myopathies VCEP RYR1 v2.0 specifications (GN150 for AD and GN179 for AR, both evaluated given undetermined mode of inheritance), the variant meets 1 Pathogenic Supporting criterion (PM2) and 1 Benign Supporting criterion (BP4), yielding acmg_score = 0. Neither the Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic rules nor the Benign (>=2 BS or 1 BA1) / Likely Benign (1 BS + 1 BP or >=2 BP) combining rules in GN150/GN179 are met. Because this is a non-canonical intronic polypyrimidine tract deletion with no predicted splicing impact (SpliceAI max_delta = 0.099) and no literature or case evidence, the classification is VUS (leaning benign).

aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), two Pathogenic Moderate criteria are met: PM1 (Moderate, residue 178 within N-terminal domain residues 1-552) and PP3 (Moderate, REVEL=0.951 > 0.85), while PM2 is Not Applicable per GN012 and no case-counting (PS4), functional (PS3), or segregation (PP1) evidence was found in available sources. Because GN012 defines no custom combining rules, generic ACMG/AMP combining rules apply: 2 Moderate criteria (ACMG score = 4) do not reach the >=3 Moderate threshold for Likely Pathogenic and classify as VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_evidence.PVS1: Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012): malignant hyperthermia susceptibility is caused by gain-of-function variants in RYR1; additionally, NM_000540.2:c.742G>C (p.Gly248Arg) is a missense variant per annotate_variant (VEP).
aiva_evidence.PS1: Met at Strong per GN012: NM_000540.2:c.742G>A encodes the same amino acid substitution (p.Gly248Arg) and is an established pathogenic variant without PS1, verified in annotate_variant (VEP colocated rs1801086, A:pathogenic), PMID:27857962 (EMHG-validated MH-causative mutation with HEK293 functional evidence), PMID:33564012, and PMID:9788730; SpliceAI max_delta=0.037 per annotate_variant rules out splicing impact.
aiva_evidence.PS2: Not met per GN012: no confirmed de novo inheritance data reported in clinical context or retrieved literature.
aiva_evidence.PS3: Met at Moderate per GN012 (PMID:33767344): HEK293T Ca2+ release assay in PMID:27857962 (n>=8 replicates with WT, empty vector, and positive/negative controls) demonstrated significantly increased sensitivity to the RYR1 agonist 4-CmC for p.Gly248Arg (EC50=270+/-6.00 uM vs WT 481+/-15.00 uM, p=8.21e-4), corroborated by PMID:9334205.
aiva_evidence.PS4: Met at Supporting per GN012: gnomAD v4.1 joint popmax AF is 2.23e-5 (<=0.00006 threshold) per annotate_variant, with 1.0 MH case point across unrelated probands carrying c.742G>C (PMID:21804810, 0.5 pt for MH event) and c.742G>A/C (PMID:36245440, 0.5 pt for MH event), alongside additional p.Gly248Arg MH cohorts in PMID:11575529 and PMID:21157159.
aiva_evidence.PM1: Met at Supporting per GN012: residue Gly248 lies within the N-terminal MH hotspot region (residues 1-552) per GN012 and PMID:33767344; downgraded from Moderate to Supporting because PS1 is applied.
aiva_evidence.PM2: Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012): PM2 is dropped for RYR1/MHS as absence in controls is not supportive alone; variant is also present in gnomAD v4.1 (10/1,613,844 alleles, AF=6.20e-6) per annotate_variant.
aiva_evidence.PM3: Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012): malignant hyperthermia susceptibility is an autosomal dominant disorder (confirmed in Verified Clinical Context).
aiva_evidence.PM4: Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012): causative RYR1 MHS variants are predominantly missense; additionally, c.742G>C is a missense SNV.
aiva_evidence.PM5: Not met per GN012: colocated c.742G>A produces the same amino acid (p.Gly248Arg, captured by PS1), and c.742G>T (p.Gly248Trp) is only listed as likely_pathogenic in VEP colocated_variants without established independent pathogenicity or lower Grantham score (Gly->Trp 184 vs Gly->Arg 125).
aiva_evidence.PM6: Not met per GN012: no assumed de novo observations reported in clinical context or retrieved literature.
aiva_evidence.PP1: Not met per GN012: while familial segregation of p.Gly248Arg with MH is mentioned in PMID:1354642 and PMID:36245440, >=3 informative meioses specifically for c.742G>C could not be directly verified from retrieved primary text.
aiva_evidence.PP2: Not Applicable per ClinGen MHS VCEP (GN012): RYR1 is not considered constrained for missense variation under GN012 (despite gnomAD v4 mis_z=4.54, oe_mis_upper=0.89 per gnomad_constraint).
aiva_evidence.PP3: Met at Moderate per GN012: REVEL score is 0.883 per annotate_variant (VEP), exceeding the GN012 calibrated threshold of >0.85 for PP3_Moderate.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), which provide no VCEP-specific combining_rules so generic ACMG/AMP 2015 combining rules apply. aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Malignant Hyperthermia Susceptibility VCEP specifications for RYR1 v2.0 (GN012), which govern over generic rules for this phenotype and autosomal dominant inheritance. Under GN012, PVS1, PM2, and PM4 are marked Not Applicable because MHS is caused by gain-of-function variants in RYR1 rather than loss-of-function, and absence in gnomAD is not used alone. Two Supporting pathogenic criteria are met: PM1 at Supporting (codon 4837 lies in the C-terminal hotspot residues 4631-4991 per GN012) and PP3 at Supporting (SpliceAI DS_DL=0.992 >= 0.2 per Walker 2023; REVEL per GN012 is N/A for a deletion), giving 2 Supporting (0 VS, 0 S, 0 M, 2 P; acmg_score=2). Using the standard combining rules (GN012 specifies no separate combining table), 2 Supporting criteria do not reach Likely Pathogenic or Benign/Likely Benign and therefore yield VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Monogenic Diabetes Expert Panel (MDEP) specifications for HNF4A v4.0 (doc_id: GN085). The variant GRCh37 20:42984264G>T (NC_000020.11:g.44355624G>T; NM_175914.5:c.-181G>T) meets 1 Pathogenic Moderate criterion (PM1: nucleotide c.-181 within the VCEP-defined c.-178 to c.-181 HNF1A/HNF1B binding site in the HNF4A P2 promoter) and 1 Pathogenic Supporting criterion (PM2: absent in gnomAD, <=0.000003). Under the GN085 combining rules, 1 Moderate + 1 Supporting (acmg_score=3) does not reach Likely Pathogenic (which requires at least 1 Strong + 1 Moderate, 3 Moderate, 2 Moderate + 2 Supporting, or 1 Moderate + 4 Supporting), resulting in VUS (leaning pathogenic), consistent with ClinVar allele 2743234. Although PMID:38855865 provides supportive functional evidence of impaired HNF-1A binding and reduced transactivation in transfected HeLa/MIN6 assays, exact % WT luciferase values were not reported in text to confirm the GN085 <60% threshold for PS3_Supporting; notably, even with PS3_Supporting added (1 Moderate + 2 Supporting), the GN085 classification remains VUS (leaning pathogenic).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Cerebral Creatine Deficiency Syndromes VCEP SLC6A8 specifications (GN027 v2.1) and ClinGen SVI Splicing Subgroup guidance (PMID:37352859). aiva_rationale: Under the ClinGen Brain Malformations VCEP specifications for MTOR (GN018; PMID:35997716), 3 Moderate criteria (PS2_Moderate, PS4_Moderate, PM5: 3 x 2 = 6 points) and 4 Supporting criteria (PS3_Supporting, PM1_Supporting, PM2_Supporting, PP2: 4 x 1 = 4 points) are met, with no benign criteria met, yielding a total score of 10 points. aiva_rationale: Per VARIANT-CLASS PRECEDENCE, NM_001354304.2:c.510-735_912+434del (GRCh37 chr12:103245031-103249845) is a 4,815 bp (>1 kb) copy-number loss and is therefore governed by the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al. 2020, Genet Med 22:245-257, PMID:31690835; erratum PMID:33731880), alongside ClinGen SVI PVS1 specifications (PMID:30192042) and ClinGen PAH VCEP v2.1 (doc_id GN006). Interval size: 4,815 bp completely within 1 protein-coding RefSeq gene (PAH, GRCh37 chr12:103230667-103352219). ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map ratings for PAH (HGNC:8582): Haploinsufficiency Score = 30 (Gene associated with autosomal recessive phenotype, MONDO:0009861) and Triplosensitivity Score = 0 (No evidence available). Scoring under Riggs et al. 2020 Copy Number Loss metric: Section 1A (contains protein-coding sequence, exons 7-9 of NM_001354304.2 / coding exons 6-8) = 0 pts; Section 2E (both breakpoints within PAH; deletes 403 bp of coding sequence c.510_912, causing a frameshift upstream of c.1285 with NMD predicted in an established autosomal recessive LOF disease gene, meeting PVS1 Very Strong) = +0.90 pts; Section 3A (0-24 genes, 1 gene) = 0 pts; Section 4 (no published cases, case-control studies, ClinVar records, or common population CNV overlap identified) = 0 pts; Section 5F (inheritance information unavailable/uninformative, no quantitative plasma Phe/BH4 assay or in-trans variant data) = 0 pts. Total CNV score = 0.90 points, which meets the Likely Pathogenic threshold (0.90 to 0.98 points; Pathogenic requires >=0.99 points). Under the schema ACMG summary tally, the single invoked criterion PVS1 (Very Strong) equals acmg_score 8.

aiva_rationale: Because NM_001354304.2:c.442-1377_509+226del spans 1,671 bp (>1 kb; GRCh37 chr12:103260151-103261821; VEP ENST00000553106.1:c.442-1380_509+223del), it is evaluated under the ACMG/ClinGen Technical Standards for the Interpretation and Reporting of Constitutional Copy-Number Variants (Riggs et al. 2020, PMID:31690835). Interval metrics: 1,671 bp intragenic deletion wholly within 1 protein-coding gene, PAH (HGNC:8582). ClinGen Dosage Sensitivity Map (ISCA-9235, CCID:007610) rates PAH as Haploinsufficiency Score 30 (Gene Associated with Autosomal Recessive Phenotype) and Triplosensitivity Score 0 (No Evidence). Copy-number loss scoring: Section 1A = 0 (contains protein-coding exon 5 of PAH, c.442_509); Section 2A-2D = 0 (HI=30, not HI=3); Section 2E = +0.90 (PVS1 Very Strong per ClinGen SVI PVS1 PMID:30192042 and PAH VCEP v2.1 doc_id GN006, as deletion of the 68 bp exon 5 upstream of c.1285 removes canonical splice sites, disrupts the reading frame, and is predicted to undergo NMD in a gene where LOF is the established mechanism of autosomal recessive PKU; consistent with AR CNV scoring in Lemire et al. 2023 PMID:37873196); Section 2F-2H = 0 (not benign; gnomAD pLI=0, LOEUF=1.27); Section 3A = 0 (1 protein-coding gene); Section 4E = +0.30 max (overlapping single-exon 5 PAH deletions reported in >3 unrelated PKU probands with highly specific PKU phenotype across PMID:16931086, PMID:17221866, PMID:22513348, and PMID:40473815); Section 4O = 0 (absent from VEP/gnomAD); Section 5F = 0 (inheritance information unavailable). Total CNV score = 0.90 + 0.30 = 1.20 points (>=0.99 threshold = Pathogenic; acmg_score=8 for PVS1). Note: per Riggs et al. 2020, variant classification is uncoupled from clinical significance; for autosomal recessive PKU, clinical diagnosis requires biallelic (homozygous or compound heterozygous in trans) pathogenic PAH variants.

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Congenital Myopathies VCEP specifications for DNM2 (GN148). On the pathogenic side, 1 Strong (PS3: variant-specific KI-Dnm2(R465W) mouse models plus GTPase/polymer assays) and 2 Supporting (PP2: missense constraint mis_z=5.53; PP3: REVEL=0.830 >= 0.7) are met, satisfying GN148 combining rule '1 Pathogenic Strong + >=2 Pathogenic Supporting' for Likely Pathogenic (+6 points). On the benign side, 1 Strong (BS1: gnomAD v4.1 exomes NFE AC=2, FAF95=3.20e-07 >= 1.5e-07) is met (-4 points; net acmg_score=2), which alone does not reach Benign (>=2 Strong or BA1) or Likely Benign (1 Strong + 1 Supporting, or >=2 Supporting). Because only the pathogenic side reaches a classification under GN148 combining rules, the classification is Likely Pathogenic with medium confidence due to the discordant gnomAD v4.1 BS1 frequency (consistent with mild/late-onset expressivity).

aiva_rationale: Evaluated under ClinGen Myeloid Malignancy VCEP specifications for RUNX1 v3.1 (ClinGen:GN008). Three pathogenic criteria are met: PVS1 at Strong (4 points; canonical exon 8/intron 8 splice donor deletion with SpliceAI DS_DL=0.977 and patient RNA-seq in PMID:38019014 showing exon 8 skipping/in-frame TAD disruption and cryptic donor usage), PS4 at Moderate (2 points; 2 unrelated probands/families with inherited thrombocytopenia/FPDMM in PMID:38019014 and PMID:28240786), and PM2 at Supporting (1 point; absent from gnomAD per annotate_variant). Note that GRCh37 VCF input 21:36171596 ACTTG>A maps in VEP to c.965_967+1del while the stated HGVS is NM_001754.5:c.967+2_967+5del (VCF anchor shift across the exon 8 donor), both disrupting the same exon 8/intron 8 donor motif. Per ClinGen:GN008 point-based combining rules (Likely Pathogenic: 6 to 9 points), the total score of 7 points classifies this variant as Likely Pathogenic.
